evaluation.applied_residual_wrench_clock: same original IMU/replay timestamps; interpolation in dynamics uses this same mean and uncertainty law

GA.clock: original mocap header timestamps inside IMU support; reconstruction Slerp; no extrapolation

GA + magnetic output.clock: original mocap header timestamps inside IMU support; reconstruction Slerp; no extrapolation

model + residual wrench.clock: original mocap header timestamps inside IMU support; reconstruction Slerp; no extrapolation

evaluation.covariance_approximation: local Gaussian; conservative bounds for modeled shared terms, not systematic-bias coverage
evaluation.mocap_comparison_clock: original supported mocap stamps; Slerp reconstruction only; no extrapolation

method.covariance: full native-SG temporal overlap sandwich plus uncentered residual score middle, all tau/physical cross retained
method.sensor_lever_assumption: FC origin used as nominal accelerometer origin; physical IMU origin not independently calibrated
method.sg_edge_policy: same helper native local-polynomial shifted windows; no invented observations
method.whitening: fixed at nominal physical parameters and command-period initial taus; quasi-GLS, not full parameter-dependent Gaussian likelihood

observation_source: native IMU gyro and accelerometer; no ongoing mocap

orientation_method.acceleration_covariance_isotropization: lambda_max(C_eff)*I Loewner upper envelope; static sensor noise remains trace(S)/3*I
orientation_method.estimated_sensor_lag_covariance_units: physical tau seconds squared, order gyro/acceleration
orientation_method.gyro_prediction_convention: body-frame right increment, right-end native angular velocity
orientation_method.magnetic_noise: current individual-reading sensor variance plus initial-reference individual-reading variance
orientation_method.magnetic_observation_policy: new-observation mask only; output factors never carried forward
orientation_method.method: native ProbTF Bingham gyro+acceleration recurrence; magnetic fusion only in output
orientation_method.orientation_covariance: native Bingham-derived high-concentration right rotation coordinates, same A law
orientation_method.propagation: existing deterministic cubature and native quaternion-product moments; no Monte Carlo
orientation_method.shared_acceleration_attitude_information: conservative data-dependent envelope; not exact Bayes with shared observations

parameter_distribution.common_scale_gauge: physical chart projected onto existing 13-D orthogonal common-scale section; tau coordinates unaffected

provenance.mocap_policy: excluded from identification; separate initial-condition alignment and read-only evaluation

reconstruction_method.imu_acceleration_bound: 3*(2*(accel + joint gyro/alpha local noise) + orientation + full-parameter); unknown-cross matrix Cauchy bounds
reconstruction_method.imu_initial_offset_bound: initial FC lever cancellation exact at t0; later-time unknown-correlation bound can be discontinuous at t0
reconstruction_method.imu_mean: lever-corrected CoG specific force integrated piecewise-linearly; FC reconstructed with Bingham output attitude; direct sensor-origin integration also saved
reconstruction_method.imu_state_bound: 4 times block-diagonal marginal majorants permits arbitrary output-block correlations; not an exact posterior
reconstruction_method.imu_temporal_bound: spectral-norm isotropic majorant with Minkowski integration, permitting arbitrary SG-overlap/time correlations
reconstruction_method.initial_condition_frame: FC nominal sensor-origin position/velocity in world; body-to-world wxyz quaternion
reconstruction_method.initial_state_source_cross_assumption: initial rotation, past-prefix velocity and fixed-tau gyro noise blocks independent; parameter/source cross then bounded by factor 3
reconstruction_method.model_applied_wrench_uncertainty: same full parameter factor plus additional empirical persistent-wrench factor, under the same three-source covariance bound as trajectory
reconstruction_method.model_discrepancy_mean: full native IMU-fit residual wrench time series, body frame about CoG, added to the mean dynamics at every RK4 stage
reconstruction_method.model_discrepancy_uncertainty: additional persistent zero-mean empirical envelope from uncentred second moment of the IMU-fit residual wrench; not exact sensor-noise covariance or a systematic-error coverage guarantee
reconstruction_method.model_integration: canonical full-six-DoF ambient-13 RK4 with exact thrust-history values at all stages; intermediate quaternion-rate/Jacobian sign transported to raw stage hemisphere, full-step normalization differentiated
reconstruction_method.model_parameter_uncertainty: all 16 quotient/log-tau modes propagated as rectangular Gram factor; first-order sensitivity approximation
reconstruction_method.model_residual_wrench_interpolation: piecewise linear on original IMU stamps, no extrapolation; identical interpolation for all 16 parameter derivatives
reconstruction_method.model_residual_wrench_parameter_jacobian: w=G*e; dw/dz=G*de/dz+(dG/dz)*e; same parameters/log-taus as model, not an independent fixed force
reconstruction_method.predicted_sensor_columns: underlying physical gyro/specific-force inputs before forward sensor lag
reconstruction_method.sensor_extrinsic_assumption: known nominal FC frame/position, not independently calibrated physical chip lever
